description: An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential role offers a chance to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence within a supportive environment.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards and fostering a culture of high-quality care. This leadership position is critical to maintaining the facility's reputation for outstanding service and patient outcomes.We are seeking a visionary leader with a passion for healthcare and a proven track record in skilled nursing administration. This role offers a competitive salary and the chance to join a team committed to excellence.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the State of Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated leadership and management skills, with a focus on operational efficiency and quality patient care.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
